summary: First-party English and Spanish discovery found Palmira’s official IDEP cadastral viewer and IGAC’s public cadastral ArcGIS service. IGAC schema/CRS metadata was obtained, but bounded anonymous parcel requests returned a pagination error or timed out; no parcel ID or polygon was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: See city-1549-palmira.json freshResearch and requestsAndEndpointChecks; all executed routes and statuses are recorded there.
